newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil breaks resistance on aggressive buying.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil breaks resistance on aggressive buying.

text.p: IPE May gas oil futures broke through month-old resistance on Tuesday amid very aggressive buying from a couple of large players, dealers said.

May gas oil was trading at $167.75 at 1019 GMT, $2.00 up from Monday's close and 75 cents up from the $167 quadruple top formed earlier this month. It earlier touched $168 a tonne, the highest point on the May chart since March 27.
"There is some very aggressive buying from a couple of prominent people," one dealer said. "It looks very strong," he said and added he was not aware of any fundamental news behind the move.
"There were some massive stops behind $167 and it looks like they have been triggered," another dealer added.
